title: Omukuumi w’akabonero ak’obwakatonda
intro: Munda mu kifo ekitukuvu ekitukuvu, emmeeme ey’omukisa yakuzibwa wansi w’okulabirirwa okw’obwakatonda. Ono ssekinnoomu yali ategekeddwa okukola omulimu omukulu mu kintu eky’ekyamagero, n’afuuka obujulizi ku maanyi n’amagezi ga Allah agataliiko kkomo. Olugendo lwabwe lwabikkula amazima amazibu, nga lusomooza endowooza era nga luteekawo akabonero ak’enjawulo eri obuntu bwonna.
clues: Nalondebwa era ne ntukuzibwa Allah okusinga abakyala bonna ab’omulembe gwange.
Nateekebwa wansi w’obukuumi bwa nnabbi omutuukirivu, eyasanga eby’okulya nga biweereddwa mu ngeri ey’ekyamagero mu kisenge kyange eky’okusabamu.
Neeyawula ku maka gange ne ngenda mu kifo eky’obwannannyini okusinza Allah.
Malayika yandabikira mu ngeri y’omusajja atuukiridde, ng’aleeta amawulire ag’omwana omulongoofu, wadde nga nnali simanyi musajja.
Oluvannyuma lw’obulumi obw’okuzaala, nnalagirwa okukankanya ekikolo ky’enkindu nsobole okufuna eby’okulya ebipya.
Bwe nnaddayo eri abantu bange nga basitudde omwana wange omuwere, bambuuza ebibuuzo, naye mutabani wange omuwere mu ngeri ey’ekyamagero yayogera ng’asinziira ku kitanda ng’anwolereza.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Okusuulibwa mu muliro ogwaka olw’okwegaana ebifaananyi
Okuzaala omwana mu ngeri ey’ekyamagero nga talina kitaawe
Okumira ennyanja ekika kya whale olw’okusuula omulimu
trial.answer: Okuzaala omwana mu ngeri ey’ekyamagero nga talina kitaawe

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Omwana eyayogedde ng’asinziira ku kitanda ng’awolereza muzadde waabwe
outcome.answer: Omwana eyayogedde ng’asinziira ku kitanda ng’awolereza muzadde waabwe

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. (3:42)
